2608.24968v1.title: CFT$_3$ Realizations and Celestial Representation Theory of the $\mathcal{L}_{\Lambda}w_{1+\infty}$ Algebra
2608.24968v1.abstract: We study CFT$_3$ realizations and celestial representations of the $\mathcal{L}_{\Lambda}w_{1+\infty}$ algebra. Free scalar and Dirac theories yield the same one-particle light-ray action. This action extends to the critical $O(N)$ model at $N=\infty$, while regulated moments reproduce the pairwise algebra in the large-but-finite-$N$ correlators studied here. In the celestial hard-graviton module, the projected null conditions select $\Delta=3$ uniquely, and a closed raising subalgebra annihilates $G^+_3$ exactly. The nonzero-$\Lambda$ quadratic Casimir has eigenvalue three throughout the hard module, and the exact annihilators and low-spin Ward identities give compatible differential-difference equations for celestial correlators.

classification.title_zh: CFT$_3$实现与$\mathcal{L}_{\Lambda}w_{1+\infty}$代数的天球表示论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了$\mathcal{L}_{\Lambda}w_{1+\infty}$代数的CFT$_3$实现和天球表示。自由标量和Dirac理论产生相同的单粒子光射线作用。该作用在$N=\infty$的临界$O(N)$模型中扩展，而调节矩重现了这里研究的有限但大$N$关联函数中的成对代数。在天球硬引力子模中，投影零条件唯一地选择$\Delta=3$，一个闭的提升子代数精确地湮灭$G^+_3$。非零$\Lambda$的二次Casimir在整个硬模中特征值为三，精确的湮灭子和低自旋Ward恒等式为天球关联函数提供兼容的差分-微分方程。
classification.one_liner: 研究$\mathcal{L}_{\Lambda}w_{1+\infty}$代数在CFT$_3$中的实现及其天球表示，特别关注硬引力子模块。

2608.25239v1.title: Single-Minus Graviton Amplitudes from Matrix Theory
2608.25239v1.abstract: The $n$-point single-minus graviton amplitudes are nonzero in a special kinematic region that preserves some supersymmetry when embedded in supergravity. We compute these amplitudes within the BFSS matrix theory by relating them to an index problem considered by A. Sen. More precisely, the single-minus amplitudes are obtained from an index that counts BPS states in the Coulomb branch of four-dimensional ${\cal N}=4$ super Yang-Mills. We explicitly check this relation in a specific kinematic region by computing the index using BPS wall-crossing formulae and matching it to the gravity result. We further employ BPS wall-crossing to show that the index satisfies a tower of $w_{1+\infty}$ soft theorems in any kinematic regime, again matching gravity. Finally, we show that for certain kinematics, the single-minus amplitudes can be realized by scattering a graviton off a plane wave.

classification.title_zh: 矩阵理论中的单负引力子振幅
classification.abstract_zh: n点单负引力子振幅在嵌入超引力时保持一些超对称的特殊运动学区域中非零。我们在BFSS矩阵理论中计算这些振幅，通过将它们与A. Sen考虑的一个指标问题联系起来。更精确地说，单负振幅从一个计数四维N=4超Yang-Mills库仑分支中BPS态的指标获得。我们通过使用BPS wall-crossing公式计算指标并将其与引力结果匹配，在特定运动学区域明确检查了这一关系。我们进一步利用BPS wall-crossing来表明该指标在任意运动学区域满足一个w_{1+∞}软定理塔，再次与引力匹配。最后，我们证明对于某些运动学，单负振幅可以通过引力子被平面波散射来实现。
classification.one_liner: 利用BFSS矩阵理论中的BPS指标计算单负引力子振幅，并验证其满足w_{1+∞}软定理。

2608.25287v1.title: Beyond Strong Subadditivity: Holographic Entropy Inequalities Along Renormalization Group Flows
2608.25287v1.abstract: Strong subadditivity (SSA) on a common light cone gives the Casini-Huerta entropic proof of the three-dimensional $F$-theorem. We ask whether holographic entropy inequalities beyond SSA similarly constrain renormalization group flows for which every intermediate theory admits a semiclassical holographic description. For small, disjoint deformations of a common light-cone region, we show that the second-order response of a broad class of balanced holographic inequalities depends only on pairwise correlations already controlled by SSA. A six-party example shows that the full finite inequality nevertheless contains genuinely multipartite information, so its disappearance is a limitation of the second-order expansion rather than of the inequality itself. Two natural finite constructions do not recover the missing information. We nevertheless find two ways in which information beyond SSA survives. A five-party inequality bounds the rate at which a conditional correlation grows as one region is enlarged. Separately, a continuum limit of the odd-cyclic inequalities gives a constraint on the angular shape dependence of entanglement entropy, and Lorentz symmetry relates this constraint to radial evolution. Thus holographic entropy inequalities beyond SSA do constrain entanglement along RG flows, although we do not obtain a second universal analogue of the $F$-function.

classification.title_zh: 超越强次可加性：沿重整化群流的全息熵不等式
classification.abstract_zh: 在共同光锥上的强次可加性（SSA）给出了三维 F-定理的 Casini-Huerta 熵证明。我们研究超越 SSA 的全息熵不等式是否也能约束那些每一个中间理论都具有半经典全息描述的重整化群流。对于共同光锥区域的小且不重叠的形变，我们表明一大类平衡全息不等式的二阶响应仅依赖于已经被 SSA 控制的成对关联。一个六方例子表明，完整的有限不等式仍然包含真正的多体信息，因此该信息的消失是二阶展开的局限，而非不等式本身的局限。两种自然的有限构造无法恢复缺失的信息。然而，我们发现超越 SSA 的信息以两种方式存活。一个五方不等式限制了当一个区域扩大时条件关联的增长速率。另外，奇循环不等式的连续极限给出了对纠缠熵角向形状依赖的约束，且洛伦兹对称性将该约束与径向演化联系起来。因此，超越 SSA 的全息熵不等式确实约束了沿 RG 流的纠缠，尽管我们没有得到第二个普适的 F 函数类比物。
classification.one_liner: 研究超越强次可加性的全息熵不等式对重整化群流的约束，表明它们虽不能提供第二个F函数，但仍能以多种方式限制纠缠演化。

2608.25438v1.title: Decoupling saddles of the gravitational index and the Farey tail
2608.25438v1.abstract: We first construct general saddles of the five-dimensional gravitational supersymmetric index with $S^1\times\mathbb{R}^4$ asymptotics, carrying an arbitrary number of electric charges and Gibbons-Hawking centers. We then uplift the three-charge configurations to type IIB supergravity, obtaining solutions asymptotic to $S^1\times \mathbb{R}^4\times S^1\times {\rm K}3$, carrying D1-D5-P charges. Upon taking a decoupling limit, these solutions yield asymptotically Euclidean AdS$_3\times S^3\times {\rm K}3$ candidate saddles of the dual CFT$_2$ elliptic genus. We focus on the two-center saddles, which involve three integers specifying an orbifold action. Depending on these integers, the saddles may or may not possess a Euclidean horizon, and may be smooth or exhibit orbifold singularities. We give the on-shell action of these two-center saddles in the appropriate ensemble and establish a precise match with the Farey-tail expansion of the elliptic genus. The horizonless saddles are the Euclidean version of fractional spectral-flow solutions previously discussed in the literature, corresponding to $({\rm AdS}_3\times S^3)/\mathbb{Z}_k$ orbifolds. The black hole saddles are modular images of the horizonless ones. They generalize the well-known ${\rm SL}(2,\mathbb{Z})$ family of BTZ black holes by placing it in the background of the $\mathbb{Z}_k$ orbifold. We also consider the asymptotically AdS$_3\times S^3$ solutions arising as decoupling limit of five-dimensional black ring and black lens saddles, provide their on-shell action and confirm that they do not contribute to the D1-D5 elliptic genus.

classification.title_zh: 引力指标的退耦鞍点与 Farey 尾部
classification.abstract_zh: 我们首先构造了具有 $S^1\times\mathbb{R}^4$ 渐近形式的五维引力超对称指标的一般鞍点，携带任意数量的电荷和 Gibbons-Hawking 中心。然后我们将三电荷构型提升到 IIB 超引力，得到渐近于 $S^1\times \mathbb{R}^4\times S^1\times {\rm K}3$ 并携带 D1-D5-P 电荷的解。通过取退耦极限，这些解给出渐近欧几里得 AdS$_3\times S^3\times {\rm K}3$ 的候选鞍点，对应于对偶 CFT$_2$ 椭圆属。我们专注于两中心鞍点，它们涉及三个整数来指定轨道折叠作用。根据这些整数，鞍点可能具有或没有欧几里得视界，并且可能是光滑的或表现出轨道奇点。我们给出了这些两中心鞍点在合适系综中的在壳作用，并建立了与椭圆属 Farey 尾展开的精确匹配。无视界鞍点是先前文献中讨论过的分数谱流解的欧几里得版本，对应于 $({\rm AdS}_3\times S^3)/\mathbb{Z}_k$ 轨道折叠。黑洞鞍点是这些无视界鞍点的模图像。它们将著名的 ${\rm SL}(2,\mathbb{Z})$ BTZ 黑洞族推广到 $\mathbb{Z}_k$ 轨道折叠背景中。我们还考虑了作为五维黑环和黑洞透镜鞍点退耦极限的渐近 AdS$_3\times S^3$ 解，给出了它们的在壳作用，并确认它们对 D1-D5 椭圆属没有贡献。
classification.one_liner: 该文构造了五维引力指标的一般鞍点，并在退耦极限下与 D1-D5 椭圆属的 Farey 尾展开精确匹配，推广了 BTZ 黑洞族。

2608.25782v1.title: PEE threads and bit-threads in BTZ black brane and finite-cutoff AdS$_3$
2608.25782v1.abstract: We develop PEE thread flows for the planar BTZ black brane and finite-cutoff holography. Exact geodesic-distance kernels define source-resolved PEE thread currents whose superposition gives divergenceless bit-thread fields. In BTZ, boundary-boundary and boundary-horizon sectors reproduce the entanglement contour and thermal horizon flux. At finite cutoff, the two-point PEE kernels are smooth and select macroscopic flows that are generically non-geodesic despite being built from geodesic elementary threads. We compare these PEE-selected flows with independent normal-geodesic bit-thread flows and show that they saturate the same RT bottleneck while differing in boundary calibration, endpoint pairing and off-bottleneck structure. The resulting constructions make explicit both the endpoint organization of finite-cutoff entanglement and the nonuniqueness of holographic max flows.

classification.title_zh: BTZ黑膜和有限截止AdS₃中的PEE线程与bit-thread
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为平面BTZ黑膜和有限截止全息发展PEE线程流。精确的测地线距离核定义了源分辨的PEE线程电流，其叠加给出无散度的bit-thread场。在BTZ中，边界-边界和边界-视界扇区再现纠缠轮廓和热视界通量。在有限截止处，两点PEE核是光滑的，并选择宏观流，这些流通常是非测地线的，尽管由测地线基本线程构建。我们将这些PEE选择的流与独立的正常测地线bit-thread流进行比较，并表明它们饱和相同的RT瓶颈，而在边界校准、端点配对和瓶颈外结构上有所不同。所得构造明确了有限截止纠缠的端点组织和全息最大流的非唯一性。
classification.one_liner: 研究了BTZ黑膜和有限截止AdS₃中的PEE线程流，揭示了全息最大流的非唯一性及有限截止纠缠的端点结构。

2608.25783v1.title: PEE threads and bit threads in gravitational subregions of AdS
2608.25783v1.abstract: Motivated by the kinematic-space description of gravitational subregions \cite{Basu:2026hbg}, we allow partial entanglement entropy (PEE) threads to be sourced not only from the asymptotic boundary, but also from boundaries of subregions. Based on this setup, we develop a framework to construct configurations for PEE threads and bit threads sourced from surfaces in the AdS bulk. The situations we have analyzed include the Poincar\'e AdS$_3$ and the planar BTZ black brane with an end-of-the-world (EOW) brane, and the entanglement wedges of boundary multi-intervals. We construct novel configurations of PEE threads and bit threads in these situations, which shed new light in our understanding of the AdS$_3$/BCFT$_2$ correspondence and the holography defined in the entanglement wedge motivated by surface/state correspondence. A notable feature we found is that, although the elementary PEE threads are geodesics, the integral curves of the coarse-grained bit-thread current are generically not geodesics. Across the explicit constructions, the integrated source currents reduce to endpoint distance-difference potentials, which make divergencelessness, the norm bound and bottleneck saturation geometrically transparent. Our results clarify how boundary, brane, horizon and RT-surface degrees of freedom participate in holographic entanglement and provide a concrete link between PEE, bit threads, subregion kinematic space and the surface/state correspondence.

classification.title_zh: PEE 线程和位线程在 AdS 引力子区域中
classification.abstract_zh: 受引力子区域的运动学空间描述启发，我们允许部分纠缠熵（PEE）线程不仅从渐近边界产生，也可以从子区域的边界产生。基于这一设置，我们发展了一个框架来构造源自 AdS 体内部表面的 PEE 线程和位线程的构型。我们分析的情形包括带有端世界（EOW）膜的 Poincaré AdS$_3$ 和平面 BTZ 黑洞膜，以及边界多区间的纠缠楔。我们在这些情形中构造了 PEE 线程和位线程的新颖构型，这为 AdS$_3$/BCFT$_2$ 对应的理解以及受表面/状态对应启发的纠缠楔中的全息定义提供了新的视角。我们发现的一个显著特征是，虽然基本 PEE 线程是测地线，但粗粒化位线程电流的积分曲线一般不是测地线。在显式构造中，积分源电流简化为端点距离差势，这使得无散性、范数界和瓶颈饱和在几何上变得透明。我们的结果阐明了边界、膜、视界和 RT 面自由度如何参与全息纠缠，并提供了 PEE、位线程、子区域运动学空间与表面/状态对应之间的具体联系。
classification.one_liner: 研究 PEE 线程和位线程在 AdS 体中的来源和配置，揭示边界、膜、视界和 RT 面在纠缠中的角色。

2608.24975v1.title: Emergence of Kastor-Traschen spacetime from a nonlinear Dirac system
2608.24975v1.abstract: We establish a uniqueness theorem in four-dimensional spacetime, demonstrating that a nonlinear spinor system naturally constrains the background geometry to the Kastor-Traschen spacetime, which describes dynamical, cosmic multi-black-holes. By analyzing a nonlinear field equation where the super-covariant derivative of a Dirac spinor is sourced by intrinsic fermion currents, we evaluate its integrability under two physical requirements: a phase-locking condition enforcing a real hermitian product $\overline{\psi}_R \psi_L$, and a pure-electric source condition. We show that the field equation uniquely compels the spinor to be an eigenvector of the super-covariant Dirac operator, with the eigenvalue dynamically identified as the Hubble constant of the de Sitter background. These results provide a novel geometric mechanism wherein both the cosmological constant and dynamical black hole configurations spontaneously emerge from fermion condensates.

classification.title_zh: 从非线性狄拉克系统涌现Kastor-Traschen时空
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在四维时空中建立了一个唯一性定理，表明非线性旋量系统自然地将背景几何约束为Kastor-Traschen时空，该时空描述动态的宇宙多黑洞。通过分析一个非线性场方程，其中狄拉克旋量的超协变导数由固有费米子流源动，我们在两个物理要求下评估其可积性：相位锁定条件强制实数厄米乘积 \overline{\psi}_R \psi_L，以及纯电来源条件。我们表明，该场方程唯一地迫使旋量成为超协变狄拉克算子的本征矢，其特征值被动态识别为de Sitter背景的哈勃常数。这些结果提供了一种新的几何机制，其中宇宙学常数和动态黑洞构型自发地从费米子凝聚中涌现。
classification.one_liner: 证明了非线性狄拉克系统唯一约束背景为Kastor-Traschen时空，揭示宇宙学常数与动态黑洞从费米子凝聚涌现的几何机制。

2608.24994v1.title: Low-Frequency Gravitational Bremsstrahlung and Memory in a Medium
2608.24994v1.abstract: Gravitational radiation from the early Universe offers a powerful window into physics beyond the Standard Model (SM). In this paper, we investigate the low-frequency tail of gravitational radiation produced by the decay of massive particles. The energy spectrum in Minkowski space-time, $dE/d\omega$, exhibits two distinct regimes: a flat bremsstrahlung/memory spectrum above a characteristic cutoff frequency and a suppressed quadratic frequency scaling below it. The typical rate of momentum change of the decay products determines the cutoff frequency. We calculate $dE/d\omega$ in two independent but equivalent ways: using Weinberg's soft graviton theorem and by solving the equations of motion. This further establishes the connection between Weinberg's soft graviton theorem and the gravitational memory formula, which we generalize to incorporate the effects of final-state scattering. We then compute the cosmological stochastic gravitational energy spectrum $h^2\Omega_{\rm h}$ generated by many particle decays in the early Universe. We demonstrate that $h^2\Omega_{\rm h}$ exhibits linear scaling with frequency above the cutoff frequency, transitioning to cubic scaling below it. Our findings reveal a suppression of the low-frequency signal compared to a naive linear extrapolation, with implications for detection prospects. Our results also reveal the connection between bremsstrahlung and memory in the context of cosmological stochastic gravitational energy spectra from the early Universe.

classification.title_zh: 介质中的低频引力轫致辐射与记忆
classification.abstract_zh: 来自早期宇宙的引力辐射为超越标准模型物理学提供了有力窗口。本文研究大质量粒子衰变产生的引力辐射的低频尾部。闵可夫斯基时空中的能量谱 dE/dω 在特征截止频率以上呈平坦的轫致辐射/记忆谱，在截止频率以下呈压低的二次频率标度。衰变产物动量变化的典型速率决定截止频率。我们以两种独立但等价的方式计算 dE/dω：利用 Weinberg 软引力子定理和求解运动方程。这进一步建立了 Weinberg 软引力子定理与引力记忆公式之间的联系，并将其推广以纳入末态散射效应。随后我们计算早期宇宙中大量粒子衰变产生的宇宙学随机引力能量谱 h^2Ω_h。我们证明 h^2Ω_h 在截止频率以上随频率线性标度，在以下转为三次标度。我们的发现揭示与简单线性外推相比低频信号受到压低，这对探测前景有影响。结果还揭示了早期宇宙宇宙学随机引力能谱背景下轫致辐射与记忆之间的联系。
classification.one_liner: 研究早期宇宙粒子衰变产生的低频引力轫致辐射与引力记忆，并给出随机引力波背景的频谱标度。

2608.24997v1.title: Anti-Ultralocality and Plateau Models of Inflation
2608.24997v1.abstract: Anti-ultralocality refers to the growth of spatial gradient terms relative to velocity terms in the coupled Einstein--scalar field equations. It is a characteristic feature of decelerated expansion before the onset of inflation. Previous numerical relativity studies have shown that anti-ultralocality prevents the onset of inflation in models with power-law inflaton potentials. In this paper, we show that models with plateau-shaped inflaton potentials, which are considered to be the simplest way to generate a tensor-to-scalar ratio below current observational upper limits, are especially vulnerable to anti-ultralocality effects. The reasons are the flatness of the plateau and the energy density gap of $\sim 10$ orders of magnitude between the Planck density and the plateau potential energy. To study the problem, we develop a protocol for assessing the viability of inflationary models in general, and we apply it to a plateau potential using a previously validated numerical relativity code. We find that, starting from generic initial conditions, the growth of gradient terms in the Einstein equations relative to non-gradient terms either prevents inflation from lasting for enough $e$-folds or triggers a phase of quantum runaway. We show that the fine-tuning of initial conditions necessary to avoid these issues becomes more severe as the energy scale of inflation is made smaller, disfavoring common approaches for reducing the tensor-to-scalar ratio.

classification.title_zh: 反超局域性与高原型暴胀模型
classification.abstract_zh: 反超局域性指的是耦合的爱因斯坦-标量场方程中空间梯度项相对于速度项的增长。它是暴胀开始前减速膨胀的一个特征。之前的数值相对论研究表明，在幂律暴胀子势的模型中，反超局域性阻碍了暴胀的开始。在本文中，我们表明具有高原形暴胀子势的模型——这被认为是产生低于当前观测上限的张标比的最简单方式——尤其容易受到反超局域性效应的影响。原因在于高原的平坦性以及普朗克密度与高原势能之间约10个数量级的能量密度差距。为了研究这个问题，我们开发了一个评估暴胀模型可行性的通用方案，并将其应用于一个高原势，使用先前经过验证的数值相对论代码。我们发现，从一般的初始条件出发，爱因斯坦方程中梯度项相对于非梯度项的增长要么阻止暴胀持续足够的e折数，要么触发量子失控阶段。我们表明，随着暴胀能量尺度的降低，避免这些问题所需的初始条件微调变得更加严重，这不利于降低张标比的常见方法。
classification.one_liner: 数值相对论研究表明高原势暴胀模型对反超局域性效应特别脆弱，需要严重的初始条件微调，且在低能标下问题加剧。

2608.25159v1.title: 21-cm Brightness Temperature in a Unified-Dark-Sector Horndeski Theory
2608.25159v1.abstract: We investigate the impact of scalar-tensor theories on the 21cm brightness temperature. We consider a specific model in Horndeski scalar-tensor theory in which dark matter and dark energy in the framework of shift-symmetric generalized Galileon theories was described and an effective unified cosmic fluid was obtained. We calculate the Hubble parameter of the model and we plot the curve of the evolution of the 21-cm temperature in a specific range of the redshift parameter $z$ and compare it to the curve corresponding to $\Lambda$CDM paradigm.

classification.title_zh: 统一暗区Horndeski理论中的21厘米亮温度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究标量张量理论对21厘米亮温度的影响。我们考虑Horndeski标量张量理论中的一个具体模型，该模型在平移对称广义Galileon理论框架下描述暗物质与暗能量，并得到有效的统一宇宙流体。我们计算该模型的哈勃参数，绘制特定红移参数z范围内21厘米温度的演化曲线，并与ΛCDM范式的结果进行比较。
classification.one_liner: 在平移对称Horndeski统一暗区模型中计算哈勃参数，研究21厘米亮温度演化并与ΛCDM比较。

2608.25436v1.title: Stationary Dirac condensates around Kerr black holes
2608.25436v1.abstract: Ultralight bosonic fields can form macroscopic clouds around rotating black holes, whereas the existence of analogous stationary fermionic condensates is strictly constrained by their intrinsic spin. Here we establish a complete geometric and kinematic framework to resolve the stationary bound states of massive Dirac fields on Kerr and Kerr-Newman backgrounds. By mapping the Kerr-Dirac system to a globally integrated sourced radial problem, we strictly isolate the boundary constraints dictated by horizon causality. The angular sector reveals a fundamental topological distinction: because the azimuthal quantum number is strictly half-integer, the regular boundary branches prevent the local field density from vanishing on the rotation axis. Consequently, rotating fermionic clouds inherently form globally filled, oblate geometries, in stark contrast to the hollow toroidal structures characteristic of scalar condensates. Crucially, our radial indicial analysis unveils the exact mathematical origin of the absence of synchronized Dirac hair. Precisely at the kinematic synchronization locus, the Frobenius matrix of the Dirac operator is non-defective and entirely devoid of logarithmic divergences. Without these singular branches to be selectively excised by boundary regularity, the physical burden of existence falls entirely onto the causal flux barrier, which strictly trivializes the zero-source amplitude. This synchronization veto demonstrates that a black hole's capacity to support macroscopic stationary fields is governed not merely by superradiant kinematics, but by the profound interplay between local horizon causality and quantum spin statistics.

classification.title_zh: Kerr黑洞周围的稳态Dirac凝聚
classification.abstract_zh: 超轻玻色子场可以在旋转黑洞周围形成宏观云，而类似的稳态费米子凝聚的存在受到其固有自旋的严格限制。在这里，我们建立了一个完整的几何和运动学框架来解决Kerr和Kerr-Newman背景上的大质量Dirac场的稳态束缚态。通过将Kerr-Dirac系统映射为全局积分的源径向问题，我们严格分离了由视界因果性所规定的边界约束。角向部分揭示了一个基本的拓扑区别：因为方位角量子数是严格半整数，规则边界分支阻止局域场密度在旋转轴上消失。因此，旋转费米子云本质上形成全局填充的扁球几何，与标量凝聚的特征性空心环状结构形成鲜明对比。关键的是，我们的径向指数分析揭示了同步Dirac毛缺失的确切数学起源。恰好在运动学同步点处，Dirac算子的Frobenius矩阵是非缺陷的，并且完全没有对数发散。如果没有这些可被边界正则性选择性切除的奇异分支，存在的物理负担完全落在因果通量势垒上，该势垒严格使零源振幅平凡化。这种同步否决表明，黑洞支持宏观稳态场的能力不仅受超辐射运动学控制，还受到局域视界因果性与量子自旋统计之间深刻相互作用的影响。
classification.one_liner: 该文建立了Kerr和Kerr-Newman背景下大质量Dirac场稳态束缚态的完整框架，指出同步Dirac毛缺失源于视界因果性与量子自旋统计的相互作用。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究Kerr/Kerr-Newman黑洞上的Dirac场稳态凝聚，属于经典引力背景上的场论分析，与用户重点标签'经典引力/广义相对论'直接相关。

2608.25722v1.title: Reconstructing $f(R)$ gravity from generalized entropies: exact Lagrangians
2608.25722v1.abstract: Generalized horizon entropies are widely used as theoretical modifications of the Bekenstein-Hawking area law, but through the Wald construction they may also encode modifications of the underlying gravitational dynamics. We reconstruct metric $f(R)$ gravity from prescribed entropy-area relations and show that the procedure is intrinsically branch dependent through the required area-curvature map. On the maximally symmetric branch, where $A=48\pi/R$ exactly, the reconstruction reduces to a single quadrature and can be performed non-perturbatively. We obtain closed-form Lagrangians for several generalized entropies and show that an entropy term $a~S_{BH}^{q}$ generates a curvature term proportional to $R^{2-q}$. In particular, Kaniadakis entropy produces a $1/R$ correction, while logarithmic entropy generates an $R^2\ln R$ term. We further derive a branch-independent criterion, $\partial_{R}^{2} f=(ds/dR)d(S/s)/ds$, relating Dolgov-Kawasaki stability directly to the entropy functional, together with $m_{\rm sc}^2=S'(s)/(3f_{RR})$ on the maximally symmetric branch. Comparison with the fixed-mass Schwarzschild-de Sitter branch reveals different reconstructed Lagrangians and reversed stability properties. Finally, the weak-isolated-horizon boost charge reproduces the original generalized entropy. These results establish a direct non-perturbative link between generalized horizon thermodynamics and modified gravitational dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 从广义熵重建$f(R)$引力：精确拉格朗日量
classification.abstract_zh: 广义视界熵被广泛用作Bekenstein-Hawking面积律的理论修正，但通过Wald构造，它们也可能编码底层引力动力学的修正。我们从给定的熵-面积关系重建度规$f(R)$引力，并表明该过程通过所需的面积-曲率映射本质上依赖分支。在最大对称分支上，其中$A=48\pi/R$精确成立，重建简化为单一求积，可以非微扰地进行。我们获得了几个广义熵的闭式拉格朗日量，并表明熵项$aS_{\mathrm{BH}}^q$产生正比于$R^{2-q}$的曲率项。特别地，Kaniadakis熵产生$1/R$修正，而对数熵产生$R^2\ln R$项。我们进一步推导了一个分支无关的判据$\partial_R^2 f=(ds/dR)d(S/s)/ds$，将Dolgov-Kawasaki稳定性直接与熵泛函联系起来，以及在最大对称分支上有$m_{\mathrm{sc}}^2=S'(s)/(3f_{RR})$。与固定质量Schwarzschild-de Sitter分支的比较揭示了不同的重建拉格朗日量和相反的稳定性性质。最后，弱孤立视界boost荷再现了原始广义熵。这些结果在广义视界热力学和修正引力动力学之间建立了直接的非微扰联系。
classification.one_liner: 从广义熵重建$f(R)$引力，得到精确拉格朗日量并联系稳定性。

2608.25860v1.title: Vacuum energy problem in anti-de Sitter space
2608.25860v1.abstract: We investigate the cosmological evolution of a universe with an initially large negative vacuum energy, corresponding to an anti-de Sitter (AdS) space-time. Such a universe inevitably contracts and collapses into a singularity. To prevent this collapse, we propose a dynamical mechanism of vacuum energy compensation based on a scalar field non-minimally coupled to the curvature scalar. Numerical and analytical calculations demonstrate that the suggested mechanism completely compensates the gravitational impact of the vacuum energy, successfully driving the curvature to zero. As a result, the universe avoids the singularity and evolves into a power-law expansion, typical for a radiation-dominated cosmology.

classification.title_zh: 反德西特空间中的真空能问题
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究初始具有大负真空能的宇宙的宇宙学演化，该情态对应于反德西特（AdS）时空。这样的宇宙不可避免地收缩并塌缩成奇点。为防止这种塌缩，我们提出一种基于与曲率标量非最小耦合的标量场的真空能补偿动力学机制。数值和解析计算表明，该机制完全补偿了真空能的引力影响，成功地将曲率驱动为零。结果，宇宙避免了奇点，并演化为典型的辐射主导宇宙学的幂律膨胀。
classification.one_liner: 提出标量场非最小耦合机制补偿负真空能，避免AdS宇宙收缩奇点并实现辐射主导膨胀。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论框架下的宇宙学机制研究，涉及标量场非最小耦合与奇点避免，与用户经典引力支线相关，但不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

2512.06881v2.title: Carrollian Conformal Theories in Momentum Space
2512.06881v2.abstract: We consider the Carrollian conformal field theories involving scalar operators in the momentum representation. The momentum space Ward identities are explicitly solved to obtain the different branches of 2 and 3 point Carrollian conformal correlators in the momentum space. These branches are symmetry-allowed structures, characterized by different analytic structures in the Carrollian energies, and are not necessarily realized simultaneously in a single consistent theory. For specific values of the conformal dimensions, the three-point functions in momentum space exhibit logarithmic behaviour. This has no analogue in position space and instead originates from singularities in the Fourier transform relating position and momentum space correlators. We also analyze the Carrollian limit of CFT 2 and 3 point functions of scalar operators in momentum space. By taking different scalings of CFT correlators with respect to the speed of light, we obtain different branches of the Carrollian conformal correlators in the momentum space.

classification.title_zh: 动量空间中的 Carrollian 共形理论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑涉及标量算符的 Carrollian 共形场论在动量表象中的行为。我们显式求解动量空间 Ward 恒等式，得到动量空间中 2 点和 3 点 Carrollian 共形关联函数的不同分支。这些分支是对称性允许的结构，以 Carrollian 能量中不同的解析结构为特征，并不一定在单一相容理论中同时实现。对于特定共形维数，动量空间三点函数表现出对数行为。这在坐标空间中没有对应，而是源于联系坐标空间与动量空间关联函数的傅里叶变换中的奇点。我们还分析了动量空间中标量算符 CFT 2 点和 3 点函数的 Carrollian 极限。通过对 CFT 关联函数关于光速采取不同标度，我们获得动量空间中 Carrollian 共形关联函数的不同分支。
classification.one_liner: 系统求解动量空间中 Carrollian CFT 标量算符的 2、3 点关联函数分支，并分析 Carrollian 极限。

2602.18924v4.title: Critical Temperatures of Excited Holographic Superconductors in Born--Infeld Electrodynamics on a Reissner--Nordstr\"om--AdS Background
2602.18924v4.abstract: We study the ground state (GS) and the two lowest excited states (ES1, ES2) of a probe holographic superconductor with Born-Infeld (BI) electrodynamics on a charged Reissner-Nordstrom-AdS (RN-AdS) black hole background. Distinguishing these background geometries by their extended-thermodynamic pressure P=-Lambda/8pi requires the electric charge Q: the neutral Schwarzschild-AdS metric admits only one positive horizon for any M,L^2>0 and cannot support the SBH/LBH transition. Working on the correctly identified RN-AdS geometry, we set up the scalar/BI-gauge probe sector, formulate the linear eigenvalue problem for the onset of condensation, and solve it by a shooting method. We obtain T_c of GS, ES1, ES2 at three representative pressures (P>P_c, P=P_c, P<P_c) and five values of the BI parameter b in {0,1,2,3,5} Q^-1. T_c increases monotonically with P and is suppressed by b for all three states, more for the excited states (~2% for GS versus ~10-27% for ES1/ES2 at b=5 Q^-1). A finer scan in b shows the suppression follows a quadratic law T_c(b)/T_c(0)=1-alpha b^2, with alpha(GS)~7.4e-4, alpha(ES1)~4.1e-3, alpha(ES2)~1.1e-2, consistent with the radial profiles of the threshold modes: the ground-state mode is concentrated near the horizon, while the nodal excited-state modes extend further into the bulk. We present this as a nodal-sensitivity picture rather than a proven mechanism, and make it concrete with an explicit leading-order BI correction to the bulk gauge field: this differential coupling has not previously been isolated and quantified, independently of the back-reacted problem left to a companion study. These results clarify how BI nonlinearity interacts with the nodal structure of excited states, giving a sharper linear baseline for the back-reacted, finite-temperature holographic superconductor.

classification.title_zh: Born-Infeld电动力学中Reissner-Nordström-AdS背景上的激发全息超导体的临界温度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在带电的Reissner-Nordström-AdS（RN-AdS）黑洞背景上，研究了具有Born-Infeld（BI）电动力学的探针全息超导体的基态（GS）和两个最低激发态（ES1，ES2）。通过扩展热力学压力P=-Λ/8π来区分这些背景几何需要电荷Q：中性的Schwarzschild-AdS度规对任何M,L^2>0只有一个正视界，无法支持SBH/LBH转变。在正确识别的RN-AdS几何上，我们建立了标量/BI规范探针扇区，构造了凝聚开始的线性特征值问题，并用打靶法求解。我们在三个代表压力（P>P_c，P=P_c，P<P_c）和BI参数b的五个值（{0,1,2,3,5} Q^-1）下获得了GS、ES1、ES2的T_c。T_c随P单调增加，并被b抑制，对所有三个态都是如此，激发态更明显（在b=5 Q^-1时，GS约2%，ES1/ES2约10-27%）。更精细的b扫描显示抑制遵循二次律T_c(b)/T_c(0)=1-alpha b^2，其中alpha(GS)~7.4e-4，alpha(ES1)~4.1e-3，alpha(ES2)~1.1e-2，与阈值模式的径向分布一致：基态模式集中在视界附近，而带节点的激发态模式延伸到体内部更远。我们将其呈现为节点敏感性图像而非已证实的机制，并用对体规范场的显式一阶BI修正使其具体化：这种微分耦合以前没有被独立地分离和量化，独立于留给后续研究的反作用问题。这些结果阐明了BI非线性如何与激发态的节点结构相互作用，为反作用的有限温度全息超导体提供了更清晰的线性基线。
classification.one_liner: 研究Born-Infeld电动力学下RN-AdS背景中全息超导体激发态的临界温度，发现激发态对BI非线性更敏感。

2602.21658v3.title: Dirichlet, Neumann, Mixed and self-dual holography: (self-dual) Yang-Mills theory
2602.21658v3.abstract: Motivated by applications of self-dual theories to the AdS/CFT correspondence, we study self-dual Yang-Mills theory (SDYM) and its relation to Yang-Mills theory and to Chalmers-Siegel theory with Dirichlet, Neumann, and mixed boundary conditions. A Fefferman-Graham analysis of SDYM is performed to identify its boundary CFT data. We make a proposal for self-dual holography that defines $3d$ ``self-dual CFTs''. The bulk-to-bulk and boundary-to-bulk propagators for SDYM and for Yang-Mills/Chalmers-Siegel theory with mixed boundary conditions are derived in Feynman and axial gauges. Three- and four-point functions are computed in the spinor-helicity formalism, and the relations among the results in the various theories are clarified. The flat limit and the gauge-(in)dependence of the results are analyzed.

classification.title_zh: Dirichlet、Neumann、混合与自对偶全息：(自对偶)杨-米尔斯理论
classification.abstract_zh: 受自对偶理论在AdS/CFT对应中应用的启发，我们研究了自对偶杨-米尔斯理论及其与杨-米尔斯理论和Chalmers-Siegel理论在Dirichlet、Neumann和混合边界条件下的关系。对自对偶杨-米尔斯理论进行了Fefferman-Graham分析以确定其边界CFT数据。我们提出了自对偶全息方案，定义了三维“自对偶CFT”。在Feynman规范和轴向规范下推导了自对偶杨-米尔斯以及具有混合边界条件的杨-米尔斯/Chalmers-Siegel理论的体-体和边界-体传播子。在旋量-螺旋度形式中计算了三点和四点函数，并阐明了各种理论结果之间的关系。还分析了平直极限和结果的规范(不)依赖性。
classification.one_liner: 研究自对偶Yang-Mills全息，提出自对偶CFT定义，并计算传播子与关联函数。

2604.21447v3.title: $O(d,d)$ symmetric gravity and finite coupling holography
2604.21447v3.abstract: We construct asymptotically AdS$_5$ black brane solutions in a theory of gravity with an infinite series of curvature corrections. The action is based on an $O(d,d)$ symmetric ansatz which has been argued to describe the classical NSNS sector of string theories. We find that, for this general class of theories, the singularity behind the horizon is not resolved by the curvature corrections. The approach to the singularity is however generically modified, being characterized by different Kasner exponents. We also show that, in the presence of a non-trivial dilaton, a slight generalization of these types of curvature corrections can generate dynamically a negative cosmological constant in the region of small coupling. This provides a mechanism through which asymptotic freedom could emerge in the hypothetical string dual of QCD.

classification.title_zh: O(d,d) 对称引力与有限耦合全息
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了一个包含无穷曲率修正的引力理论中的渐近AdS5黑膜解。该作用基于O(d,d)对称ansatz，此ansatz被认为描述弦论经典NSNS扇区。我们发现，对于这一类普遍的理论，视界后的奇点不会被曲率修正所解决。然而，趋近奇点的方式通常会被修改，表现为不同的Kasner指数。我们还证明，在存在非平凡dilaton时，这类曲率修正的一种轻微推广可以在小耦合区域动态产生负宇宙学常数。这提供了一种机制，通过该机制，渐近自由可能出现在假想的QCD弦对偶中。
classification.one_liner: 构造O(d,d)对称高阶曲率修正下的AdS5黑膜，发现奇点仍存但Kasner指数改变，并指出可动态生成负宇宙学常数为QCD弦对偶提供渐近自由机制。

2606.27093v3.title: Index saddle for the D1-D5-P black string and its decoupling limit
2606.27093v3.abstract: Boruch, Emparan, Iliesiu, and Murthy recently discussed index saddles for 5d black strings, showing that the black string saddle admits a decoupling limit to a complex, finite-temperature BTZ \times S^2 saddle that computes the index of the dual CFT. In this paper, we pursue an analogous construction for the D1-D5-P black string. We construct a four-charge index saddle in the four-dimensional STU model as the BPS limit of the non-extremal four-charge black hole, and show that it exhibits the new form of attraction. We then uplift it successively to five and six dimensions, via the 4D-5D connection and a chain of string dualities, to obtain the gravitational index saddle for the D1-D5-P black string. We take a systematic decoupling limit of this index saddle and obtain the BTZ \times S^3 saddle that computes the index of the D1-D5 CFT.

classification.title_zh: D1-D5-P 黑弦的指标鞍点及其退耦极限
classification.abstract_zh: Boruch、Emparan、Iliesiu 和 Murthy 近期讨论了 5d 黑弦的指标鞍点，表明黑弦鞍点存在退耦极限，可得到复有限温度 BTZ×S^2 鞍点，用以计算对偶 CFT 的指标。本文对 D1-D5-P 黑弦进行类似构造。我们在四维 STU 模型中构造了四电荷指标鞍点，作为非极端四电荷黑洞的 BPS 极限，并展示其具有新形式的吸引机制。随后通过 4D-5D 联系及一串弦对偶性逐级提升到五维和六维，得到 D1-D5-P 黑弦的引力指标鞍点。我们对该指标鞍点取系统性退耦极限，获得计算 D1-D5 CFT 指标的 BTZ×S^3 鞍点。
classification.one_liner: 构造 D1-D5-P 黑弦的指标鞍点，并通过退耦极限得到计算 D1-D5 CFT 指标的 BTZ×S^3 鞍点。

2608.04599v2.title: Probe Dependence of the Imaginary Part of HTEE
2608.04599v2.abstract: We investigate the holographic timelike entanglement entropy (HTEE) in a five-dimensional anisotropic background, dual to a strongly coupled anisotropic plasma. Using the complex extremal surface method, we compute the HTEE analytically in the high-temperature, small-anisotropy limit $aT \ll 1$. We consider two different orientations of the boundary timelike interval: one perpendicular to the anisotropy direction and one parallel to it. We find that the imaginary part of the HTEE is not a universal property of the geometry but depends sensitively on the orientation of the extremal surface relative to the anisotropy. This demonstrates that the imaginary part arising from the UV logarithmic divergence is a probe-dependent quantity. Our results suggest that the imaginary part of HTEE can serve as a diagnostic of the coupling between the extremal surface and the anisotropic degrees of freedom of the dual field theory.

classification.title_zh: 时间型全息纠缠熵虚部的探针依赖性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了五维各向异性背景中的全息时间型纠缠熵（HTEE），该背景对偶于强耦合各向异性等离子体。利用复杂极值曲面方法，我们在高温、小各向异性极限$aT \ll 1$下解析计算了HTEE。我们考虑了边界类时间隔的两种取向：一种垂直于各向异性方向，一种平行于各向异性方向。我们发现HTEE的虚部不是几何的普适性质，而是依赖于极值曲面相对于各向异性的取向。这表明由紫外对数发散产生的虚部是一个探针依赖的量。我们的结果表明，HTEE的虚部可以作为极值曲面与对偶场论各向异性自由度之间耦合的一个诊断。
classification.one_liner: 研究了在五维各向异性背景中时间型全息纠缠熵虚部对极值曲面取向的依赖性。

2608.19428v2.title: Holographic Bit Threads from String-Diagrammatic Quantum Information Flow
2608.19428v2.abstract: Bit threads, arising as the convex dual of the minimal-surface formula for holographic entanglement entropy, are line-like structures with nontrivial bulk trajectories. Their physical picture has long been associated with Bell-pair interpretations, yet the meaning of their detailed trajectories, particularly their nonuniqueness, remains unclear. We propose to apply Coecke's notion of quantum information flow (QIF) in protocol-network geometry, developed within categorical quantum mechanics, to a holographic setup, and show that its trajectories within the discrete holographic bulk---the tensor network---obey the divergence-free and density-bound conditions of bit threads. From this process-centered perspective, bit-thread nonuniqueness becomes natural: for a given resource state, different protocols realizing the same distillation task can give rise to different QIF trajectories. We further analyze stabilizer-type holographic tensor networks using ZX string diagrams and show that QIF trajectories can probe finer entanglement structure beyond the level captured by entanglement entropy.

classification.title_zh: 全息比特线：弦图式量子信息流视角
classification.abstract_zh: 比特线（bit threads）是全息纠缠熵的最小曲面公式的凸对偶，表现为具有非平凡体内轨道的线状结构。其物理图像长期与 Bell 对解释相关联，但对其具体轨迹（尤其是其非唯一性）的意义仍不清楚。我们提出将范畴量子力学中 Coecke 的量子信息流（QIF）概念应用于全息张量网络这一离散全息体内，并证明其轨迹满足比特线的无散度与密度边界条件。从这种以过程为中心的观点看，比特线的非唯一性变得自然：对于给定资源态，实现同一蒸馏任务的不同协议可以给出不同的 QIF 轨迹。我们进一步用 ZX 弦图分析稳定子型全息张量网络，并表明 QIF 轨迹能够探测比纠缠熵更精细的纠缠结构。
classification.one_liner: 提出用弦图式量子信息流解释全息比特线的轨迹非唯一性，并展示其可探测纠缠熵之外的精细纠缠结构。

2105.11449v2.title: Search for sub-solar primordial black holes in low mass ratio binaries with LIGO-Virgo O2 data and implications for the primordial black hole dark matter fraction
2105.11449v2.abstract: We perform a search for binary black hole mergers with one sub-solar mass (SSM) black hole and a primary component above $\sim 2 M_\odot$ in data from the second observing run (O2) of the LIGO-Virgo detectors. Our analysis extends the parameter space explored by previous LIGO-Virgo Collaboration searches for binaries containing SSM components into a region of parameter space motivated by broad mass distributions of primordial black holes (PBHs) exhibiting a peak around $[2-3] M^{}_\odot$, which can arise from the reduction of the equation of state during the QCD phase transition in the early Universe. Four candidate events are found passing a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) threshold of 8 and a false alarm rate (FAR) threshold of 2 per year, although none are statistically significant enough to constitute a confident detection. Assuming a null result for the search, we derive PBH model-independent 90\% confidence upper limits on the PBH merger rates by estimating the sensitive volume-time of the search using simulated gravitational-wave signal injections. We interpret these observational limits using a representative broad PBH mass function bearing imprints of the thermal history of the early Universe and considering both early and late PBH binary formation channels. The resulting constraints on the PBH dark-matter fraction, $f^{}_{\rm PBH}$, depend on the assumed mass function and merger-rate prescription. For all considerations, the upper limits remain above $f^{}_{\rm PBH}=1$, indicating the O2 data from LIGO-Virgo are not sensitive enough to place meaningful constraints within the assumptions of the PBH mass model and PBH binary mergers.

classification.title_zh: 利用LIGO-Virgo O2数据搜索低质量比双星中的亚太阳质量原初黑洞及其对原初黑洞暗物质比例的约束
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在LIGO-Virgo探测器第二次观测运行（O2）的数据中，搜索了一个亚太阳质量（SSM）黑洞和主成分质量高于约2太阳质量的双黑洞并合。我们的分析将之前LIGO-Virgo合作搜索扩展到由原初黑洞（PBH）宽质量分布所激发的参数空间区域，该分布在约[2-3]太阳质量处存在峰值，这可以由早期宇宙QCD相变期间状态方程的降低而产生。我们发现四个候选事件通过了信噪比阈值为8和误报率阈值为每年2的筛选，尽管没有一个是统计学上显著到足以构成确定探测。假设搜索结果为无效，我们通过模拟引力波信号注入估计搜索的灵敏体积-时间，推导了PBH模型无关的90%置信度并合率上限。我们使用具有早期宇宙热历史印记的代表性宽PBH质量函数，并考虑早期和晚期PBH双星形成通道，对这些观测限制进行解释。对PBH暗物质比例f_PBH的约束取决于所假设的质量函数和并合率规则。在所有考虑中，上限仍高于f_PBH=1，表明LIGO-Virgo的O2数据不足以在这些PBH质量模型和PBH双星并合的假设下给出有意义的约束。
classification.one_liner: 利用LIGO-Virgo O2数据搜索亚太阳质量原初黑洞，给出并合率上限，但无法约束原初黑洞暗物质比例。

2603.17018v2.title: On deforming and breaking integrability
2603.17018v2.abstract: In this paper we study nearest-neighbour deformations of integrable models. After expanding in the deformation parameter, we identify four possible types of deformations. First there are deformations that simply break or preserve integrability. Then we find two different subtle cases. The first case is where the deformation is only integrable if all orders of the deformation parameter are taken into account. An example of these are the long-range deformations that appear in holographic models. The second case is when the deformation is perturbatively integrable to some order in the deformation parameter but can not be extended to an integrable model. In this paper we work this out for the XXZ spin chain and discuss the level statistics of each of these cases. We find numerical evidence that the onset of chaos occurs differently in each of these models. For the perturbatively integrable models, we find that the deformation strength at which chaos appears demonstrates a volume-scaling intermediate between strong and weak integrability breaking models.

classification.title_zh: 论可积性的形变与破坏
classification.abstract_zh: 在这篇论文中，我们研究了可积模型的最近邻形变。在按形变参数展开后，我们识别出四种可能的形变类型。首先是简单地破坏或保持可积性的形变。然后我们发现两种不同的微妙情况。第一种是只有当形变参数的所有阶都被考虑时，形变才是可积的。这些的一个例子是出现在全息模型中的长程形变。第二种情况是形变在形变参数的某个阶上是微扰可积的，但不能扩展为可积模型。在本文中，我们针对XXZ自旋链进行了计算，并讨论了每种情况的能级统计。我们发现数值证据表明混沌的开始在这每个模型中出现的方式不同。对于微扰可积模型，我们发现混沌出现的形变强度表现出介于强和弱可积性破缺模型之间的体积标度。
classification.one_liner: 研究可积模型的最近邻形变，识别四种类型，并用XXZ自旋链的能级统计分析混沌的出现。

2603.25729v2.title: $\theta$ Angle and Axial Anomaly in Holographic QCD
2603.25729v2.abstract: We present a bottom-up holographic description of the QCD $\theta$-vacuum and the $U(1)_A$ anomaly in five dimensions. The multi-branched $\theta$-vacuum structure emerges geometrically from a higher-dimensional gauge field, while the axial anomaly is realized through a St\"uckelberg coupling that is dual to a Chern-Simons term. In this framework, the $\eta'$ meson appears as a zero mode of bulk fluctuations, and its mass arises from the anomaly-induced St\"uckelberg term. The construction provides a transparent holographic derivation of the anomaly contribution to the $\eta'$ mass and naturally reproduces the Witten-Veneziano relation between the $\eta'$ mass and the Yang-Mills topological susceptibility.

classification.title_zh: 全息 QCD 中的 θ 角与轴反常
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个自下而上的五维全息描述 QCD θ 真空和 U(1)_A 轴反常。多分支的 θ 真空结构从高维规范场几何地涌现，轴反常通过与 Chern-Simons 项对偶的 Stückelberg 耦合实现。在该框架中，η′ 介子作为体涨落的零模出现，其质量来自反常诱导的 Stückelberg 项。该构造提供了对 η′ 质量反常贡献的透明全息推导，并自然给出了 η′ 质量与 Yang-Mills 拓扑磁化率之间的 Witten-Veneziano 关系。
classification.one_liner: 自下而上全息 QCD 构造 θ 真空与轴反常，推导 η′ 质量及 Witten-Veneziano 关系。

2605.07236v2.title: Large black holes at a finite distance: Quasi-local restricted phase space formalism
2605.07236v2.abstract: We extend the restricted phase space formalism for spherically symmetric black hole solutions of Einstein-Maxwell theory to the quasi-local regime, with the static observers located at a finite radial distance. The first law and Euler relation for the RN and RN-AdS black holes are proved to hold, but only with the inclusion of an extra pair of thermodynamic variables, {\em i.e.} the pressure $P$ and the area $A$ of the codimension-2 hypersurface on which the observers reside. For the RN black holes, the quasi-local behavior is analyzed in detail. It turns out that the RN black holes in the quasi-local description behaves significantly different from itself in the asymptotic description, but is extremely similar to the RN-AdS black holes in the asymptotic description, {\em e.g.} allowing for isocharge temperature-entropy phase transitions and lack of isovoltage temperature-entropy phase transitions. In the neutral limit, the Hawking-Page-like transitions appear in the quasi-local description which is absent in the asymptotic description. The quasi-local behavior of RN-AdS black holes is also briefly discussed, which is qualitatively identical to the asymptotic description with only quantitative differences.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 有限距离处的大黑洞：准局域限制相空间形式
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦理论中球对称黑洞解的限制相空间形式推广到准局域情形，即静态观察者位于有限径向距离处。我们证明了RN和RN-AdS黑洞的第一定律和欧拉关系成立，但必须额外包含一对热力学变量，即观察者所在余维2超曲面上的压强P和面积A。对RN黑洞，我们详细分析了其准局域行为。结果表明，准局域描述中的RN黑洞与其渐近描述中的自身行为显著不同，但与渐近描述中的RN-AdS黑洞极为相似，例如允许等电荷的温度-熵相变，且缺乏等电压的温度-熵相变。在零电荷极限下，准局域描述中出现了渐近描述中不存在的Hawking-Page类相变。我们还简要讨论了RN-AdS黑洞的准局域行为，其与渐近描述定性相同，仅存在定量差异。
classification.one_liner: 将限制相空间形式推广到准局域有限距离观测者，发现RN黑洞在准局域下呈现类似RN-AdS的相变行为。

2606.19435v2.title: Deriving effective descriptions and signal predictions for dynamical gravitational systems
2606.19435v2.abstract: We investigate top-down derivations of effective descriptions of radiation from gravitational systems such as binaries. With a specified cutoff prescription, one can derive worldline effective field theories, although the associated cutoff dependence can complicate their formulation. We investigate a related effective approach in which the dynamics are parameterized by an action on the boundaries of cavities enclosing the individual bodies. We present examples of such cavity descriptions for black holes and for simple models of modified black hole behavior. We also show how cavity effective descriptions connect to observable quantities including Love numbers and aspects of wave profiles, such as the accumulated phase shifts of emitted signals. A primary motivation is to develop a systematic framework for inferring how modifications of classical black hole behavior affect gravitational wave signals. Such modifications may be motivated by the requirement that black hole evolution be consistent with quantum mechanics, or by other models of new black hole behavior. Accumulated phase shifts during the inspiral have, in particular, been argued to provide sensitivity to small new effects. To illustrate the basic principles clearly, we develop the formalism primarily for scalar radiation, and then outline its extension to gravitational perturbations.

classification.title_zh: 推导动力学引力系统的有效描述与信号预测
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究从顶层推导引力系统（如双星）辐射的有效描述。在指定截断方案下，可以推导世界线有效场论，尽管相关的截断依赖性可能使其表述复杂化。我们研究一种相关的有效方法，其中动力学由包围单个天体的空腔边界上的作用量参数化。我们为黑洞和修改黑洞行为的简单模型提供了此类空腔描述的示例。我们还展示了空腔有效描述如何与可观测物理量联系起来，包括Love数以及波形的各个方面，例如发射信号的累积相移。主要动机是开发一个系统框架，用于推断经典黑洞行为的修改如何影响引力波信号。这些修改可能源于黑洞演化必须与量子力学一致的要求，或其他新黑洞行为模型。特别是，旋进期间的累积相移被认为对小的新效应具有敏感性。为了清楚地说明基本原理，我们主要针对标量辐射发展该形式体系，然后概述其扩展到引力扰动。
classification.one_liner: 提出空腔有效描述方法，连接黑洞修改与引力波可观测信号。

2608.03593v2.title: General-relativistic structure of two-component quantum dark fermion stars
2608.03593v2.abstract: We develop a general-relativistic framework for two-component quantum dark fermion stars: equilibrium configurations of two degenerate fermion species governed by gravity, a Yukawa-mediated dark fifth force and a globally relevant Bohm quantum-pressure correction. The treatment retains the full covariant form of the nonlinear Klein--Gordon equation in the Schwarzschild interior, with closure relations valid at arbitrary compactness, from the ultralight baseline up to densities of order $0.16\,\mathrm{fm}^{-3}$ at which relativistic scalar densities and self-consistent effective fermion masses become unavoidable. Two Lagrangian parameters, the dark-fermion mass and the dimensionless ratio between the Yukawa channel and gravity, together fix the equilibrium structure; a joint measurement of mass and radius therefore constrains the dark-sector microphysics directly from gravitational-wave observables. For particle masses in the band $10^{-11}$--$10^{-10}$ eV, the configurations exhibit radii of $3$-$24\,\mathrm{km}$ and compactness in the range $0.14$-$0.34$, behaving as dual mimickers: at moderate compactness they overlap with neutron stars in mass, radius, and inspiral frequency; at the most compact end ($\kappa\sim 0.34$, $R_T/R_S\simeq 1.5$) they cross the photon sphere and could masquerade as low-mass black holes in the mass-gap region. Tidal-deformability measurements discriminate against both populations: the dimensionless tidal deformability is measurably smaller than the neutron-star value yet remains non-zero, unlike that of a genuine black hole. These objects populate the sensitivity bands of LISA, the Einstein Telescope, and Cosmic Explorer, producing astrometric microlensing signatures individually resolvable by \textit{Gaia}. The framework thus provides a reproducible and falsifiable template for constraining dark-sector properties through multi-messenger observations.

classification.title_zh: 双组分量子暗费米子恒星的广义相对论结构
classification.abstract_zh: 我们发展了一个双组分量子暗费米子恒星的广义相对论框架：两种简并费米子物种的平衡构型，受引力、汤川相互作用介导的暗第五种力和全局相关的玻姆量子压修正支配。该处理保留了施瓦西内部非线性克莱因-戈登方程的完全协变形式，闭合关系在任意紧凑度下有效，从超轻基线到约0.16 fm^-3的密度（此时相对论标量密度和自洽有效费米子质量不可避免）。两个拉格朗日参数——暗费米子质量以及汤川道与引力的无量纲比——共同决定平衡结构；因此，质量-半径联合测量可直接从引力波可观测值约束暗区微观物理。对于10^-11至10^-10 eV的粒子质量，构型呈现3-24 km的半径和0.14-0.34的紧凑度，表现出双重模拟体行为：在中等等紧凑度时，它们在中子星的质量、半径和螺旋频率上重叠；在最紧凑端，它们穿过光子球，可能在质量间隙区域伪装成低质量黑洞。潮汐形变测量可区分这两类群体：无量纲潮汐形变明显小于中子星值但非零，不同于真正的黑洞。这些天体填充LISA、爱因斯坦望远镜和宇宙探索者的灵敏度带，并产生可由盖亚卫星单独分辨的天体测量微引力透镜信号。该框架为通过多信使观测约束暗区性质提供了可重复且可证伪的模板。
classification.one_liner: 提出双组分量子暗费米子恒星的广义相对论平衡态模型，并讨论其作为中子星或低质量黑洞模拟体的可观测特征。

2608.09299v2.title: Correlated parity violation in gravity and electromagnetism from five-dimensional spacetime
2608.09299v2.abstract: Parity violation in the gravitational and electromagnetic sectors has been extensively investigated, yet the two are conventionally treated as independent phenomena. This separation, however, may be a four-dimensional prejudice. In higher-dimensional spacetime, gravity and electromagnetism may share a common geometric origin---and so, perhaps, does their parity violation. In this paper, we pursue this idea by constructing parity-violating Kaluza-Klein models in both Riemannian and teleparallel geometries. In Riemannian geometry, the simplest five-dimensional parity-violating term reduces to several complicated four-dimensional terms, including the familiar gravitational Chern-Simons term, which suffers from a ghost instability. In teleparallel geometry, however, the result is strikingly simple. The simplest five-dimensional parity-violating term reduces to only two ghost-free terms---the familiar Nieh-Yan term and the standard electromagnetic Chern-Simons term. Remarkably, the model predicts that the helicity-dependent dispersion shift for electromagnetic waves is exactly six times that for gravitational waves, $\Delta\omega^{2}_{ EM}=6\,\Delta\omega^{2}_{GW}$, a background-independent relation. This relation offers a falsifiable test of unification through joint cosmic microwave background and gravitational wave birefringence observations.

classification.title_zh: 来自五维时空的引力与电磁学中的关联宇称破坏
classification.abstract_zh: 引力与电磁领域的宇称破坏已被广泛研究，但两者通常被视为独立现象。然而，这种分离可能是四维偏见。在更高维时空中，引力与电磁可能共享几何起源——或许它们的宇称破坏也是如此。本文通过构造黎曼几何和teleparallel几何中的宇称破坏Kaluza-Klein模型来探讨这一想法。在黎曼几何中，最简单的五维宇称破坏项约化为多个复杂的四维项，包括已知的引力Chern-Simons项，该项存在鬼不稳定性。但在teleparallel几何中，结果异常简洁：最简单的五维宇称破坏项仅约化为两个无鬼项——已知的Nieh-Yan项和标准电磁Chern-Simons项。值得注意的是，该模型预言电磁波的螺旋度相关色散偏移正好是引力波的六倍：Δω²_EM = 6 Δω²_GW，这是一个与背景无关的关系。该关系为通过联合宇宙微波背景和引力波双折射观测检验统一理论提供了可证伪的途径。
classification.one_liner: 提出五维Kaluza-Klein模型，在teleparallel几何中宇称破坏约化为无鬼的Nieh-Yan项和电磁Chern-Simons项，并预言电磁波与引力波的双折射色散比值为6。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典引力与电磁学的高维统一模型，属于经典引力/广义相对论方向，与用户重点标签直接相关。

2608.25317v1.title: The relationship between spacetime singularities and regions at infinity
2608.25317v1.abstract: Ideal attached points are a core concept in general relativity for pseudo-Riemannian manifolds, and whether the spacetime can be extended with certain properties is a central consideration in their choice. This paper establishes a sufficient condition for the separability between singularities and points at infinity for any maximally extended pseudo-Riemannian manifold. We focus on the incomplete geodesics of $(\mathcal{M},g)$, and produce an envelopment $(\mathcal{M},g,\hat{\mathcal{M}})$ of the spacetime such that an incomplete geodesic $\gamma:[0,1) \rightarrow \mathcal{M}$ has an endpoint $q$ in $\hat{\mathcal{M}}$. If there is no pair of geodesics approaching $q$ which is intertwined, then $q$ is a singularity. Additionally, $q$ will not be approached by any geodesic with infinite affine parameter, and therefore cannot cover a point at infinity, thereby rendering it a {\it pure singularity} in the abstract boundary framework. We apply the Endpoint Theorem to the maximal g-boundary introduced by Graf and Beld-Serrano in arXiv:2307.11034, and also provide a result on the separability between directional singularities and pure singularities. This analysis is then applied to the Schwarzschild spacetime.

classification.title_zh: 时空奇点与无穷远区域之间的关系
classification.abstract_zh: 理想附着点是广义相对论中伪黎曼流形的核心概念，时空能否在满足一定性质下延拓是选择附着点时的中心考量。本文对任何极大延拓的伪黎曼流形建立了奇点与无穷远点可分离的充分条件。我们关注 (M,g) 的不完全测地线，并构造时空的一个包络 (M,g,\hat{M})，使得不完全测地线 γ:[0,1)→M 在 \hat{M} 中有端点 q。如果没有一对趋近 q 的测地线相互交织，则 q 是奇点。此外，q 不会被任何具有无限仿射参数的测地线趋近，因此不能覆盖无穷远点，从而在抽象边界框架中成为“纯奇点”。我们将端点定理应用于 Graf 和 Beld-Serrano 在 arXiv:2307.11034 中引入的极大 g-边界，并给出方向奇点与纯奇点之间可分离性的结果。该分析随后被应用于 Schwarzschild 时空。
classification.one_liner: 该论文在经典广义相对论的抽象边界框架下，证明了一个关于时空奇点与无穷远区域可分离性的充分条件，并将其应用于 Schwarzschild 时空。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文是纯经典广义相对论关于时空奇点与无穷远边界的研究，完全不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息，与用户关注的全息及相关方向无重叠。

2608.25368v1.title: A Generalized Class of Taub-NUT-Scalar Metrics
2608.25368v1.abstract: We consider a class of three-parameter metrics that was introduced in \cite{azizallahi2024three}. The class of metrics contain Zipoy-Voorhees (ZV) and Fisher-Janis-Newman- Winicour (FJNW) spacetimes at certain values of the parameters. We build an axially symmetric and asymptotically flat spacetime with gravitomagnetic effects by introducing a Newman- Unti-Tamburino (NUT) charge into this class of metrics via the Ehlers transformation. We investigate the physical features of this class of Taub-NUT-scalar (TNS) metrics including gravitational lensing, quasinormal mode (QNM) spectra, and test particle motion. Our results provide fresh insight on how mass, multipole moments, and gravitomagnetic fields behave in the presence of a scalar field and show the effect of the NUT charge on stability of orbits in this class of metrics.

classification.title_zh: 一类广义Taub-NUT-标量度规
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑了一类三参数度规，该度规在\cite{azizallahi2024three}中引入。这类度规在特定参数值下包含Zipoy-Voorhees (ZV)和Fisher-Janis-Newman-Winicour (FJNW)时空。我们通过Ehlers变换将Newman-Unti-Tamburino (NUT)电荷引入这类度规，构建了一个具有引力磁效应的轴对称渐近平坦时空。我们研究了这类Taub-NUT-标量(TNS)度规的物理特性，包括引力透镜、准正则模(QNM)谱和测试粒子运动。我们的结果为质量、多极矩和引力磁场在标量场存在时的行为提供了新的见解，并展示了NUT电荷对这类度规中轨道稳定性的影响。
classification.one_liner: 通过Ehlers变换构造了一类带NUT电荷的轴对称渐近平坦Taub-NUT-标量度规，并研究了其引力透镜、准正则模和粒子运动。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文直接研究经典引力/广义相对论中的时空解及其物理性质，与用户关注的经典引力/广义相对论支线高度相关。

2608.26096v1.title: Torsion balances as operational probes of semiclassical gravity: Matched-filter bounds, torque-diffusion constraints, and quantum-noise benchmarks
2608.26096v1.abstract: Calibrated torsion-balance spectra constrain deterministic and stochastic deviations from standard Newtonian gravity. Using one-sided spectra, we derive a calibrated angle-equivalent noise budget and finite-time matched-filter/Cram\'er-Rao bounds for known torque templates. For stochastic models, subtracting the calibrated standard noise budget (thermal, Newtonian, environmental, imprecision, backaction) from the observed angle spectrum yields a residual spectrum, convertible to an equivalent residual torque spectrum via calibrated torsional susceptibility. This bounds additional stationary stochastic torque noise. This frequency-resolved bound compresses to a single torque-diffusion coefficient, $D_\tau$, only in the Markovian white-noise limit; non-Markovian or colored models require the full residual spectrum. Page--Geilker branch discrimination and Fedida-Kent mixture-equivalence tests address distinct physical questions, but upon projection onto torque templates, both reduce to the same statistical matched-filter discrimination problem. For a room-temperature Cavendish benchmark, resonant thermal angle ASD is $1.36\times10^{-4}\,\mathrm{rad}/\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$, while measurement-added SQL is $3.25\times10^{-12}\,\mathrm{rad}/\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$. For the Yan \emph{et al.} search, the reported $0.3\,\mu\mathrm{rad}/\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$ sensitivity at $2.5\,\mathrm{mHz}$ yields a conservative bound $D_\tau \lesssim 2.4\times10^{-23}\,\mathrm{N^2\,m^2\,s}$, assuming white torque noise. These formulations provide an interface linking calibrated torsion-balance data, deterministic tests, and stochastic semiclassical-gravity searches, without asserting a direct test of the full relativistic semiclassical Einstein equation.

classification.title_zh: 扭秤作为半经典引力的操作探针：匹配滤波界限、扭矩扩散约束和量子噪声基准
classification.abstract_zh: 校准扭秤谱约束相对于标准牛顿引力的确定性和随机偏差。利用单边谱，我们推导了一个校准的等效角度噪声预算，以及已知扭矩模板的有限时间匹配滤波/Cramér-Rao界限。对于随机模型，从观测的角度谱中减去校准的标准噪声预算（热噪声、牛顿噪声、环境噪声、不精确性、反作用力），得到残差谱，通过校准的扭转响应可转换为等效的残差扭矩谱。这限制了额外的平稳随机扭矩噪声。这种频分辨约束仅在马尔可夫白噪声极限下压缩为单一的扭矩扩散系数 D_tau；非马尔可夫或彩色模型需要完整的残差谱。Page–Geilker 分支判别和 Fedida–Kent 混合等价检验针对不同的物理问题，但在投影到扭矩模板后，两者都归结为相同的统计匹配滤波判别问题。对于室温 Cavendish 基准，共振热角度 ASD 为 1.36e-4 rad/√Hz，而测量附加 SQL 为 3.25e-12 rad/√Hz。对于 Yan 等人的搜索，在 2.5 mHz 处报告的 0.3 μrad/√Hz 灵敏度，在假设白扭矩噪声的情况下，给出了保守界限 D_tau ≲ 2.4e-23 N²m²s。这些表述提供了一个接口，将校准扭秤数据、确定性测试和随机半经典引力搜索联系起来，而无需断言对完整相对论性半经典 Einstein 方程的直接检验。
classification.one_liner: 利用校准扭秤谱约束半经典引力的确定性/随机偏差，并推导扭矩噪声的匹配滤波、扩散系数和量子噪声界限。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及扭秤实验对经典牛顿引力偏差和半经典引力效应的测试，与用户重点中的经典引力/广义相对论支线有一定关联；但不涉及全息、凝聚态等核心研究线。

2608.25715v1.title: The properties of the first continuous gravitational waves: Optimizing pulsar timing observations for supermassive black hole binary detection
2608.25715v1.abstract: Several pulsar timing arrays have reported evidence for a nanohertz gravitational-wave background. This background is thought to arise from the superposition of signals from a population of inspiraling supermassive black hole binaries. A key test of this interpretation is the search for individually resolvable binaries whose signals emerge above this background. Here we investigate this possibility by addressing two related questions: (1) what are the most probable properties of the first resolvable binary; and (2) how can pulsar timing observations be optimized to maximize its prospects for electromagnetic identification? By simulating populations of supermassive black hole binaries constrained by evidence for the gravitational-wave background and studying the loudest binary in each simulation, we infer the expected properties of the first individually resolvable systems. If MeerKAT continues its current observing strategy for a total of 9 years, the probability of detecting an individual binary is $\approx10-27\%$. Improving the timing precision by a factor of two changes this probability to $\approx11-28\%$, whereas increasing the cadence by a factor of four gives $\approx12-30\%$. Combining both improvements yields a detection probability of $\approx12-33\%$. Furthermore, implementing a high-cadence observing campaign preferentially resolves higher-frequency systems ($\gtrsim\unit[10]{nHz}$), whose shorter orbital periods make them considerably easier to identify through electromagnetic observations than lower-frequency binaries that repeat infrequently. We discuss prospects of electromagnetic follow-up of gravitational-wave resolved binaries with current high-cadence all-sky optical surveys.

classification.title_zh: 首批连续引力波的性质：优化脉冲星计时观测以探测超大质量黑洞双星
classification.abstract_zh: 多个脉冲星计时阵列已报告了纳赫兹引力波背景的证据。该背景被认为来源于一群旋近的超大质量黑洞双星信号的叠加。检验这一解释的关键是寻找其信号突出于该背景之上的可单独分辨的双星。这里我们通过解决两个相关问题来研究这种可能性：(1) 第一个可分辨双星最可能具有什么性质；(2) 如何优化脉冲星计时观测，以最大化其电磁证认的前景。通过模拟受引力波背景证据约束的超大质量黑洞双星种群，并研究每次模拟中最响亮的双星，我们推断出首批可单独分辨系统的预期性质。如果MeerKAT继续当前观测策略总计9年，探测到单个双星的概率约为10-27%。将计时精度提高一倍，该概率变为约11-28%；而将观测频率提高四倍，则给出约12-30%。两者结合改进得到约12-33%的探测概率。此外，实施高频观测活动优先解析较高频率（≳10 nHz）的系统，其较短的轨道周期使得它们比低频重复较少的天体更容易通过电磁观测来识别。我们讨论了利用当前高频全天光学巡天对引力波分辨双星进行电磁后续观测的前景。
classification.one_liner: 通过模拟推断首个可分辨超大质量黑洞双星的性质，并优化脉冲星计时观测以提高探测与电磁证认概率。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文研究引力波天文学中的脉冲星计时和超大质量黑洞双星探测，与理论全息或经典引力理论的核心问题关联较弱。

2608.26034v1.title: Dual modes in Kerr spacetimes and the Whiting transform: Mode stability revisited
2608.26034v1.abstract: The purpose of the paper is to place Whiting's classical growing mode stability argument, extended to real frequencies by Shlapentokh-Rothman for the scalar wave equation and by Andersson, Ma, Paganini and Whiting in general, in the framework of classical PDE theory. The key steps are: a description of the dual or adjoint modes, a singular phase space pairing argument which is technically executed via the Fourier transform, followed by a standard unique continuation result. One part of our description of the dual modes connects them directly to the standard mode solutions which are smooth over the event horizon. In the zero spin case, there is a geometric interpretation of this: quasinormal modes (for non-zero real frequencies) which are smooth across the future event horizon can be extended as distributional QNM solutions by 0 through the past event horizon. We also describe the behavior of mode solutions at the bifurcate sphere.

classification.title_zh: Kerr时空中的双模与Whiting变换：模式稳定性再探
classification.abstract_zh: 本文旨在将Whiting经典的增模稳定性论证（Shlapentokh-Rothman将其推广到标量波动方程的实频率情形，Andersson、Ma、Paganini和Whiting将其推广到一般情形）置于经典PDE理论框架之中。关键步骤是：对偶模或伴随模的描述、通过傅里叶变换实现的奇异相空间配对论证，以及随后标准唯一延拓结果。我们对对偶模的描述之一将其直接与在事件视界上光滑的标准模式解联系起来。在零自旋情形下，这有一个几何解释：横跨未来事件视界光滑的（非零实频率）拟正规模可以通过0延拓穿过过去事件视界，成为分布意义的QNM解。我们还描述了模式解在分叉球处的行为。
classification.one_liner: 将Whiting模式稳定性论证置于经典PDE框架，通过双模与相空间配对重新理解Kerr时空中的模式解。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究Kerr时空中的经典引力模式稳定性与拟正规模，直接属于经典引力/广义相对论领域，并涉及QNM相关课题。

2503.13118v2.title: Gravitational Wave Effects on Radio Spectral Lines of Atomic Hydrogen: Hyperfine Splitting and Broadening Mechanisms
2503.13118v2.abstract: We explore the effects of gravitational waves (GWs) on hydrogen's radio spectral lines, focusing on the ground-state hyperfine transition and radiative transitions in highly excited Rydberg states. To analyze GW impacts on hyperfine structure, we derive Maxwell's equations in a gravitational-wave background using linearized gravity and the $3+1$ formalism. Our findings reveal that GWs induce energy shifts in hyperfine magnetic substates, modifying the 21 cm line. However, these energy shifts fall well below the detection limits of current radio astronomical instruments. For transitions in highly excited states, which produce radio recombination lines (RRL), the influence of GW manifests itself as spectral broadening, with the fractional linewidth for $\mathrm{H}n\alpha$ scaling as $\Delta\nu/\nu_0 \sim n^7\omega^2_{\mathrm{gw}}h(t)$. This suggests that RRLs could serve as probes for ultra-high-frequency GWs, particularly given that Rydberg atoms in the interstellar medium can reach quantum numbers above $n=100$. As an example of possibly detectable high frequency GW source, We investigate GWs emitted during the inspiral of planetary-mass primordial black hole binaries, where GW-induced broadening in RRLs could exceed natural broadening effects. Additionally, we examine the influence of the recently detected stochastic gravitational-wave background on hydrogen spectral lines.

classification.title_zh: 引力波对原子氢射电谱线的影响：超精细分裂与展宽机制
classification.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了引力波对氢射电谱线的影响，重点关注基态超精细跃迁和高度激发的里德伯态中的辐射跃迁。为了分析引力波对超精细结构的影响，我们使用线性化引力和3+1形式推导了引力波背景下的麦克斯韦方程组。我们的发现表明，引力波会诱导超精细磁子能级的能量移动，从而修改21厘米谱线。然而，这些能量移动远低于当前射电天文仪器的探测极限。对于高度激发态的跃迁（产生射电复合线，RRL），引力波的影响表现为谱线展宽，其中Hnα谱线的分数线宽近似为Δν/ν0 ~ n^7 ω_gw^2 h(t)。这表明射电复合线可以作为超高频率引力波的探针，尤其是考虑到星际介质中的里德伯原子量子数可超过n=100。作为一个可能可探测的高频引力波源示例，我们研究了行星质量原初黑洞双星并合过程中发射的引力波，其中引力波引起的射电复合线展宽可能超过自然展宽效应。此外，我们还研究了最近探测到的随机引力波背景对氢谱线的影响。
classification.one_liner: 研究引力波对氢21cm线和射电复合线的谱线展宽效应，提出里德伯原子可作为高频引力波探针。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文研究经典引力波对原子谱线的影响，不涉及全息对偶或AdS/CFT，仅与经典引力/广义相对论支线相关，与用户主要全息研究方向不匹配。

2602.24079v2.title: The Shape of Eccentricity: Rapid Classification of Eccentric Binaries with the Wavelet Scattering Transform
2602.24079v2.abstract: The gravitational-wave (GW) detections reported by the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA (LVK) collaboration have so far been consistent with quasi-circular compact binary coalescences (CBCs). Nevertheless, a small fraction of binaries driven to merge through dynamical interactions in dense stellar environments or in field triples may retain measurable orbital eccentricity when entering the sensitive frequency band of LVK detectors. Confident measurement of eccentricity in the LVK band would provide strong evidence for such dynamically driven mergers; however, eccentric gravitational-waveform models are computationally expensive, and performing production-level inference on all detected signals is not an efficient use of resources when eccentric signals are expected to be rare. An intermediate step between detection and analysis, in which the signal is assessed for the potential presence of eccentricity, could provide quick recommendations for which signals should undergo full eccentric inference. We apply the wavelet scattering transform (WST) to a large set of synthetic waveforms in realistic noise and assess its discriminatory power using simple linear and shallow neural-network classifiers. We find that the WST representation enables effective discrimination between eccentric and quasi-circular binaries and provides a compact multi-scale representation of GW signals. Our approach achieves ~64% percent detection accuracy at a false alarm rate of 10%, with an AUC of 0.844 and an average precision of 0.876. We also examine the ability of our classifiers to distinguish eccentricity from spin-induced precession and find robust performance across a range of spin-precession magnitudes.

classification.title_zh: 偏心率的形状：利用小波散射变换快速分类偏心双星
classification.abstract_zh: LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA（LVK）合作迄今报告的引力波（GW）探测与近圆双致密星并合（CBCs）一致。然而，在致密恒星环境或场三星通过动力学相互作用被驱动并合的少量双星，可能在进入LVK探测器灵敏频带时保留可测量的轨道偏心率。在LVK频带中可靠测量偏心率将为这类动力学驱动的并合提供有力证据；然而，偏心引力波形模型计算成本高昂，对全部探测信号进行生产级推断并非资源高效利用，因为偏心信号预期罕见。在探测与分析之间的中间步骤中，评估信号是否存在偏心，可为哪些信号应进行完整偏心推断提供快速建议。我们将小波散射变换（WST）应用于大量含实际噪声的合成波形，并使用简单线性和浅层神经网络分类器评估其判别能力。我们发现WST表示能有效区分偏心与近圆双星，并提供引力波信号的紧凑多尺度表示。我们的方法在10%误报率下达到约64%的探测准确率，AUC为0.844，平均精度为0.876。我们还检验了分类器区分偏心与自旋进动效应的能力，并在多种自旋进动幅度下发现稳健性能。
classification.one_liner: 利用小波散射变换对引力波信号进行快速分类，以识别偏心双星候选体，节省计算资源。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及经典引力波数据处理与分类，属于引力波天文学方法研究，与全息或量子引力无关。

2606.08838v2.title: Line-of-sight acceleration in compact binaries with higher harmonics and eccentricity
2606.08838v2.abstract: Direct detections of gravitational waves provide a unique opportunity to probe the astrophysical origin of compact binary mergers. The formation channels of these systems remain highly debated, and a fraction may originate in dynamical environments or active galactic nuclei. Binaries formed in such environments are expected to experience line-of-sight acceleration from their surroundings, which can imprint characteristic signatures on the observed gravitational-wave signal. Here, we re-derive the line-of-sight acceleration effects and implement them in state-of-the-art quasi-circular waveform models with precession and higher-order modes. We also implement the corrections in eccentric waveform models, applying them consistently to all contributing harmonics. Using this model, we investigate the impact of these effects on the inference of line-of-sight acceleration and analyze a few interesting GWTC events observed during the third observing run of LIGO and Virgo. We find no substantial evidence for line-of-sight acceleration in these events. We also show that an inconsistent treatment of line-of-sight acceleration between higher harmonics can lead to biased conclusions. Our model provides a robust framework for uncovering line-of-sight acceleration in current and future gravitational-wave observations, enabling more accurate probes of environmental signatures in compact-binary formation.

classification.title_zh: 含高阶谐波与偏心率的致密双星视线加速度
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波的直接探测为探测致密双星并合的天体物理起源提供了独特机会。这类系统的形成渠道仍存在很大争议，部分可能源于动力学环境或活动星系核。在此类环境中形成的双星预计会受到周围环境引起的视线加速度影响，这可能在观测到的引力波信号上留下特征印记。本文重新推导了视线加速度效应，并将其实现到具有进动和高阶模的准圆波形模型中。我们还在偏心率波形模型中实现了这些修正，并一致地应用于所有贡献谐波。利用该模型，我们研究了这些效应对视线加速度推断的影响，并分析了LIGO和Virgo第三次观测运行期间观测到的若干有趣的GWTC事件。我们在这些事件中未发现视线加速度的实质性证据。我们还表明，高阶谐波之间对视线加速度的不一致处理可能导致有偏的结论。我们的模型为在当前和未来引力波观测中发现视线加速度提供了一个稳健框架，从而能够更准确地探测致密双星形成中的环境特征。
classification.one_liner: 将视线加速度效应一致地纳入含高阶谐波和偏心率的致密双星引力波波形模型，并分析LIGO/Virgo GWTC事件未发现显著证据。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论中的引力波波形建模与致密双星环境效应研究，与用户标记的经典引力支线直接相关；但非全息或量子引力。

2608.03476v2.title: Global hyperbolicity meets order completeness
2608.03476v2.abstract: Recently, an order completeness property has attracted attention in some low regularity spacetime geometry literature, where it was named `chronocompleteness'. In this work we prove that, in the framework of standard Lorentzian geometry, this property is equivalent to global hyperbolicity. The equivalence of global hyperbolicity with other more traditional forms of order completeness is also established.

classification.title_zh: 全局双曲性与阶完备性
classification.abstract_zh: 最近，在一些低正则时空几何文献中，一个阶完备性性质引起了关注，被称为“时序完备性”。在这项工作中，我们证明在标准洛伦兹几何框架下，该性质等价于全局双曲性。同时建立了全局双曲性与其他更传统的阶完备性形式的等价性。
classification.one_liner: 证明了在标准洛伦兹几何中，'chronocompleteness'（阶完备性）等价于全局双曲性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究洛伦兹几何中的全局双曲性与阶完备性的等价关系，属于经典引力/广义相对论中的数学基础问题，与全息/量子引力无关，但直接对应经典引力支线。

2608.19257v2.title: Bayesian constraints on quadratic $f(Q)$ gravity from the ADM mass of white dwarfs
2608.19257v2.abstract: We calculate static equilibrium sequences for white dwarfs (WDs) in quadratic symmetric teleparallel gravity, f(Q)=Q+alpha Q^2, and perform a Bayesian comparison between the negative-coupling sector, general relativity (GR), and the positive-coupling sector using mass-radius measurements. Regular interior solutions are obtained by imposing the affine field equation and selecting the analytic branch C=r exp(B/2), and are matched to asymptotically flat exterior spacetimes to determine the ADM mass. The matter sector is described by a cold carbon-12 equation of state including relativistic electron degeneracy, nuclear rest energy, and Coulomb lattice corrections. Central density is marginalized at fixed alpha with a log-uniform prior. The sequences span 10^14 <= |alpha|/cm^2 <= 10^21. Positive couplings shift the compact branch toward larger radii and lower masses, whereas negative couplings produce high-mass extensions, including an admissible equilibrium configuration with M_ADM=14.34 solar masses. Using Sirius B, QS Vir, V471 Tau B, ZTF J1901+1458, and LHS 4033, we obtain conditional posterior medians alpha_-= -1.12x10^16 cm^2 and alpha_+=1.85x10^17 cm^2. With equal prior weights, the posterior probabilities for the negative, GR, and positive sectors are 0.228, 0.378, and 0.395, respectively, with ln(B_+/GR)=0.043. Current data therefore provide conditional constraints on the coupling but no direct evidence for modified gravity, emphasizing that the ADM mass prescription and admissible stellar domain must be consistently defined when using WD observations to constrain the theory.

classification.title_zh: 白矮星 ADM 质量对二次 f(Q) 引力的贝叶斯约束
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在二次对称平行引力 f(Q)=Q+αQ² 中计算白矮星的静态平衡序列，并利用质量-半径测量对负耦合区、广义相对论和正耦合区进行贝叶斯比较。通过施加仿射场方程并选取解析分支 C=r exp(B/2) 得到正则内部解，并与渐近平坦外部时空匹配以确定 ADM 质量。物质部分由冷碳-12 状态方程描述，包含相对论电子简并、核静止能量和库仑晶格修正。中心密度在固定 α 下用对数均匀先验边缘化。序列覆盖 10^14 ≤ |α|/cm² ≤ 10^21。正耦合使致密分支向更大半径和更低质量移动，而负耦合产生高质量延展，包括一个 M_ADM=14.34 太阳质量的允许平衡结构。利用 Sirius B、QS Vir、V471 Tau B、ZTF J1901+1458 和 LHS 4033，我们得到条件后验中位数 α_- = -1.12×10^16 cm² 和 α_+ = 1.85×10^17 cm²。在等先验权重下，负、GR 和正耦合区的后验概率分别为 0.228、0.378 和 0.395，ln(B_+/GR)=0.043。因此，当前数据对耦合参数给出了条件约束，但没有对修改引力提供直接证据，强调在用白矮星观测约束该理论时必须一致地定义 ADM 质量方案和可允许恒星域。
classification.one_liner: 利用白矮星质量-半径测量对二次 f(Q) 引力进行贝叶斯约束，未发现修改引力的直接证据。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究二次 f(Q) 修改引力中的白矮星，属于经典引力/广义相对论范畴，与用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”直接相关。

2608.19502v2.title: Spacetimes via Continuous posets: Old foundations and new developments
2608.19502v2.abstract: We introduce the reader to the continuous posets approach to spacetime geometry, a topic pioneered by Martin and Panangaden. We provide all relevant proofs from standard domain-theory sources to ease the transition for readers from Lorentzian geometry and general relativity. We then present new results for the spacetime interpretation. Under the identification of the way-below relation with the chronological relation $I$, we determine the unique choice for $\le$ and causality condition to obtain specific poset properties. Continuous posets require $\le=D_p$ and correspond to "past-distinction and future-reflectivity"; bicontinuous posets are causally continuous spacetimes with $\le=D$; globally hyperbolic posets are precisely globally hyperbolic spacetimes with $\le=J$ proving a necessity result beyond Martin and Panangaden's sufficiency. The theory, being phrased entirely in terms of a poset, is of low-regularity. We introduce a notion of topological Kronheimer-Penrose causal space that is sufficiently general to encompass the Lorentzian length spaces in the literature, and give weak conditions making it a (bi)continuous poset. Once a spacetime is a continuous poset, domain-theoretic constructions apply directly, e.g., completion schemes yield spacetime boundaries. We recall a few; the most natural for preserving continuity, Lawson's round-ideal completion, is proved to equal the future GKP completion. The directed completion recently studied by Gigli et al. was also proved to be equivalent to the future GKP completion; however with additional SC condition and forward approximation which we are able to remove. Finally, physical considerations on the recently established key role of past-reflectivity in black hole evaporation lead us to suggest that the spacetime is, at the fundamental level, a co-continuous poset.

classification.title_zh: 通过连续偏序集的时空：旧基础与新进展
classification.abstract_zh: 我们向读者介绍连续偏序集方法处理时空几何，这一主题由 Martin 和 Panangaden 开创。我们提供来自标准域论来源的所有相关证明，以方便来自洛伦兹几何和广义相对论的读者过渡。然后，我们展示时空解释的新结果。在把 way-below 关系等同于时间序关系 I 的识别下，我们确定 ≤ 和因果条件的唯一选择以获得特定偏序集性质。连续偏序集需要 ≤=D_p 并对应于“过去区分性和未来反射性”；双连续偏序集是因果连续时空，≤=D；全局双曲偏序集正是全局双曲时空，≤=J，证明了超越 Martin 和 Panangaden 充分性的必要性结果。该理论完全以偏序集表述，具有低正则性。我们引入一种拓扑的 Kronheimer-Penrose 因果空间概念，它足够一般以包含文献中的洛伦兹长度空间，并给出使其成为（双）连续偏序集的弱条件。一旦时空成为连续偏序集，域论构造即可直接应用，例如完备化方案产生时空边界。我们回顾几个；最自然的保持连续性的 Lawson 的 round-ideal 完备化被证明等于 future GKP 完备化。Gigli 等人最近研究的 directed completion 也被证明等价于 future GKP 完备化；然而我们能够移除额外的 SC 条件和前向逼近。最后，关于过去反射性在黑洞蒸发中近期确立的关键作用的物理考虑使我们建议，时空在基本层面上是一个 co-continuous 偏序集。
classification.one_liner: 本文综述并发展了连续偏序集描述时空几何的方法，给出其与因果结构的严格对应，并指出其可能的物理应用。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论的数学基础研究，与用户经典引力支线相关，但不涉及具体全息或凝聚态模型。

2601.18859v2.title: Energetic Ceilings and Benchmarks of Astrophysical Gravitational-Wave Backgrounds
2601.18859v2.abstract: Every astrophysical gravitational-wave background (GWB) is limited by the rest mass its sources can convert into gravitational radiation. We combine available source mass, merger factor, radiative efficiency, and merger epochs for six populations: supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs), extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs), IMBHs inspiralling into SMBHs, stellar mass binary black holes (sBBHs), binary neutron stars (BNSs), and Pop~III binary black holes. For each, we calculate a GWB benchmark and an upper limit. For SMBHBs, the local mass census of Liepold \& Ma (2024), together with the repeated-merger boost of Sato-Polito et al. (2024), allows us to compute a ceiling on the nanoHertz GWB. Anchoring the GWB to this census, and assuming one merger per SMBH, gives a benchmark of $A_{\rm bench} = 2.11^{+0.43}_{-0.32}\times10^{-15}$ at $f=1\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$. For the ceiling, we assume an infinite number of previous mergers, yielding $A_{\rm ceil}=3.76^{+0.76}_{-0.56}\times10^{-15}$, consistent with published PTA amplitudes. Under this mass function and merger model, the measured GWB amplitude therefore does not require additional SMBH mass. A measured GWB can instead constrain its source population. Using the revised NANOGrav 15-yr GWB amplitude and this SMBH census gives $f_{\rm merge}=1.11^{+1.35}_{-0.63}$, where 1 means one merger per present-day remnant. For the other five populations, comparable censuses do not yet exist, so we report upper limits from the best available source constraints, including compact-binary merger rates. Finally, the six adopted upper limit cases yield a present-day gravitational-wave energy budget of $\rho_{\rm gw}^{(6)}=3.33^{+1.32}_{-0.83}\times10^{-7}\rho_c$. A larger energy density would require more source mass, mergers, radiative efficiency, or later epochs, or point to additional source populations or new physics.

classification.title_zh: 天体物理引力波背景的能量上限与基准
classification.abstract_zh: 每个天体物理引力波背景（GWB）都受到其源能转化为引力辐射的静止质量的限制。我们结合了六类源的可用源质量、并合因子、辐射效率和并合时代：超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHBs）、极端质量比旋进（EMRIs）、中等质量黑洞旋进到超大质量黑洞、恒星质量双黑洞（sBBHs）、双中子星（BNSs）和Pop III双黑洞。对每一类，我们计算了一个GWB基准和一个上限。对于SMBHBs，Liepold & Ma (2024)的局部质量普查，结合Sato-Polito et al. (2024)的重复并合增强，使我们能够计算纳赫兹GWB的上限。将GWB锚定到该普查，并假设每个SMBH一次并合，给出基准为$A_{\rm bench} = 2.11^{+0.43}_{-0.32}\times10^{-15}$在$f=1\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$处。对于上限，我们假设无限次先前并合，得到$A_{\rm ceil}=3.76^{+0.76}_{-0.56}\times10^{-15}$，与已发表的PTA振幅一致。因此，在这种质量函数和并合模型下，测得的GWB振幅并不需要额外的SMBH质量。一个测得的GWB反而可以约束其源群体。使用修订后的NANOGrav 15年GWB振幅和该SMBH普查，给出$f_{\rm merge}=1.11^{+1.35}_{-0.63}$，其中1表示每个现今残余对应一次并合。对于其他五类源，尚不存在可比较的普查，因此我们根据最佳现有源约束报告上限，包括致密双星并合率。最后，六个采用的上限情形给出了现今引力波能量预算$\rho_{\rm gw}^{(6)}=3.33^{+1.32}_{-0.83}\times10^{-7}\rho_c$。更大的能量密度将需要更多源质量、并合、辐射效率或更晚的时代，或指向额外的源群体或新物理。
classification.one_liner: 该论文基于天体物理源质量与并合率约束，系统计算了六类源引力波背景的基准与能量上限，并指出测量到的振幅无需额外SMBH质量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究经典天体物理引力波背景，与用户重点的全息超导、QNM等方向无直接关联。

2603.07374v2.title: A Reproducible Black Hole-Neutron Star Merger Gallery Example for the Einstein Toolkit
2603.07374v2.abstract: Black hole-neutron star mergers are important sources of gravitational waves and potential electromagnetic counterparts, but publicly available numerical relativity configurations for these systems remain limited. In this work, we present a fully reproducible black hole-neutron star merger simulation performed exclusively with official Einstein Toolkit thorns and configured to target the detected event \texttt{GW230529}. We evolve the system at three resolutions, with finest grid spacings of $162$, $222$, and $310$~m, and assess the numerical robustness of the resulting dynamics and gravitational wave signal. The entire setup, from initial data to a parameter file with some of the analysis scripts, is publicly released as a new Einstein Toolkit gallery example and is distributed as part of the Hypatia release, establishing a reference black hole-neutron star merger configuration within the Einstein Toolkit.

classification.title_zh: 一个可复现的黑洞-中子星并合画廊示例：面向 Einstein Toolkit
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞-中子星并合是引力波和潜在电磁对应体的重要来源，但公开可用的数值相对论配置仍然有限。本工作展示了一个完全可复现的黑洞-中子星并合模拟，仅使用 Einstein Toolkit 官方 thorn，并针对已探测事件 GW230529 进行配置。我们在三个分辨率下演化系统，最细网格间距分别为 162、222 和 310 米，并评估所得动力学和引力波信号的数值稳健性。从初始数据到参数文件及部分分析脚本全部公开，作为新的 Einstein Toolkit 画廊示例，并随 Hypatia 版本发布，为 Einstein Toolkit 建立参考黑洞-中子星并合配置。
classification.one_liner: 发布针对 GW230529 的完全可复现黑洞-中子星并合数值相对论模拟，作为 Einstein Toolkit 新画廊示例。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究黑洞-中子星并合的经典数值相对论模拟与引力波信号，直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线。

2606.27661v2.title: Extreme Mass Ratio Inspirals in Light of Quasi-periodic Eruptions: Milli-Hertz Gravitational Wave Background
2606.27661v2.abstract: Quasi-periodic eruptions (QPEs) are repeated X-ray bursts originating in galactic nuclei. Of the many proposed models, the favored model is the disk-collision model in which a stellar mass orbiter collides with a disk formed from a tidal disruption event, generating flares twice per orbit. In this model QPEs are tracers of circular extreme mass ratio inspirals (EMRIs) and can be used to infer the EMRI formation rate and estimate their contribution to the stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB) in the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) band. Whether the secondary is a stellar-mass black hole or a main sequence star is still debated and leads to different results for the EMRI rate and SGWB. We obtain fiducial rates -- subject to systematic uncertainties -- of $R_{\rm SE} = 2.88\times10^{-6}$ per galaxy per year for stellar EMRIs and $R_{\rm BHE} = 6.07\times10^{-6}$ per galaxy per year for black hole EMRIs, then estimate their contribution to the SGWB. We find that only black hole EMRIs contribute to the 1 - 10 milliHertz band resolvable by LISA, and depending on the secondary mass and formation radius can contribute from just below the LISA sensitivity curve to roughly two orders of magnitude above it. Stellar EMRIs, being tidally disrupted before reaching the 1 - 10 milliHertz band, only contribute to sub-milliHertz frequencies and remain below the LISA sensitivity curve.

classification.title_zh: 极质量比旋进在准周期喷发视角下的研究：毫赫兹引力波背景
classification.abstract_zh: 准周期喷发（QPEs）是源自星系核的重复X射线爆发。在众多模型中，最受青睐的是盘碰撞模型，即一个恒星质量轨道天体与潮汐瓦解事件形成的吸积盘碰撞，每个轨道产生两次耀发。在该模型中，QPEs是环形极质量比旋进（EMRIs）的示踪体，可用于推断EMRI形成率，并估计其对激光干涉空间天线（LISA）频段随机引力波背景（SGWB）的贡献。次天体是恒星质量黑洞还是主序星仍存在争议，这会导致不同的EMRI速率和SGWB结果。我们获得了基准速率——受系统不确定性影响——恒星EMRIs为每星系每年2.88×10^-6，黑洞EMRIs为每星系每年6.07×10^-6，然后估计它们对SGWB的贡献。我们发现只有黑洞EMRIs对LISA可分辨的1-10毫赫兹频带有贡献，取决于次天体质量和形成半径，其贡献可从略低于LISA灵敏度曲线到比其高约两个数量级。恒星EMRIs在到达1-10毫赫兹频带之前就被潮汐瓦解，因此只贡献亚毫赫兹频率，并且低于LISA灵敏度曲线。
classification.one_liner: 利用准周期喷发约束极质量比旋进率，并评估其对LISA频段随机引力波背景的贡献。
